reason: The proposed lattice-distortion/grain-boundary-strengthening hypothesis is scientifically testable, but the paper instead varied temperature in an effectively single-crystal FeNiCrCoCu/Cu model and analyzed lattice disorder and dislocations, so it does not reconstruct the study. The key also conflates the 10 Å friction depth with the 30 Å nanoindentation depth and oversimplifies contradictory reported dislocation trends, though these errors do not affect the zero match.
